data.name: Bloodline Powers
data.description: The power of dragons flows through you and manifests in a number of ways. You must select one of the chromatic or metallic dragon types (see the Pathfinder RPG Bestiary). This choice cannot be changed. A number of your abilities grant resistances and deal damage based on your dragon type.
